# Parse each song line and add matching songs to the playlist
playlist_id = 654
added_count = 0

for line in song_lines:
    # Parse title and artists
    if " by " in line:
        title_part, artist_part = line.split(" by ", 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(",")]
    else:
        # If no " by ", treat whole line as title
        title = line.strip()
        artists = []
    
    # Search for the song
    search_results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=line, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'])
    
    # Find exact match
    matched_song = None
    for song in search_results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            song_artists = [a['name'] for a in song['artists']]
            if set(song_artists) == set(artists):
                matched_song = song
